spec_rule.what: A product rule, UI spec, or how a feature should behave
spec_rule.not_for: reporting that something is broken right now (bug_report)
examples: 拖曳到時間軸外面就取消，不要刪掉片段
Empty search results should show the last query, not a blank page

preference.what: A standing personal preference or way of working that applies to all future work
preference.not_for: an instruction for the current task, even a conditional one (command)
examples: 以後回覆一律用繁體中文
From now on, after every change always run the linter

decision.what: A lasting choice of approach, tool, library, name, layout, data store or architecture, including one made by picking an option the assistant offered
decision.not_for: picking only what to look at or do next in this conversation, such as which error to inspect first or whether to also do a side task now (choice_reply)
examples: 我們決定用 SQLite，不另外架資料庫
B (reply to: 版面要 A 單頁式還是 B 分頁式？)

project_fact.what: A fact, constraint, or environment detail about the project
project_fact.not_for: a rule for how the product should behave (spec_rule)
examples: 部署在 Zeabur 免費方案，沒有 Redis
The API only accepts UTC timestamps

feature_req.what: A feature or behavior the user wants added to or changed in the product
feature_req.not_for: a one-off operational ask such as run the tests or deploy, even when phrased politely (command)
examples: 希望匯出可以選解析度
可以讓匯出按鈕支援 PNG 嗎

bug_report.what: Reports that something is broken or behaves wrongly
bug_report.not_for: a rule about how it should work (spec_rule)
examples: 匯出之後檔案是空的
The login page crashes on Safari

command.what: A one-off operational instruction for the task at hand (push, merge, deploy, run X, edit line N), including conditional and politely phrased ones
command.not_for: a standing rule for all future work (preference)
examples: 測試過了就 push
可以幫我 rebase 一下嗎
deploy it

question.what: Asks for information or an explanation
question.not_for: asking for a product change (feature_req) or reporting breakage (bug_report)
examples: 這個 hook 是什麼時候觸發的？
Why is the build slow?

choice_reply.what: Picks what to look at or do next in this conversation from options the assistant offered
choice_reply.not_for: picking a tool, library, name, layout, data store or architecture, or anything that changes what the product or code will be (decision)
examples: 先看 B (reply to: 要先看 A 單元測試的錯還是 B 整合測試的 log？)
第一個 (reply to: 先修 A 逾時問題，或 B 錯字？)

ack.what: A bare acknowledgement that adds nothing
ack.not_for: agreeing to a proposed product change (decision)
examples: ok
收到
週末要去爬山
哈哈太好笑了
